Its whole basis left the PRD: it tested a footer 'Deactivate' / 'Activate' text control in the edit dialog (old S2-R17 / S2-R18 of the IN-REVIEW PRD). PRD v26 removed that control (S2-R18 is in the removed list; S2-R17 now means the core follows its part). A single part is now retired with the Part Status choice and Save in the part dialog (Story 13, S13-R20 to S13-R25), which the Story 13 group covers.
